written.text: Brightwater Retail Ltd is the Licensee under a Software Licence Agreement dated 10 October 2026 with Northbridge Analytics AB. Notices to the Licensee are to be sent to the address 40 Canal Street, Manchester M1 3HE. Under the terms of the agreement, the Licensee is required to pay the annual licence fee within thirty (30) days of invoice. An invoice dated 10 October 2026 for the 2026 annual licence fee remains unpaid. The amount outstanding is SEK 310,000. The breach complained of is the failure by Brightwater Retail Ltd to pay the annual licence fee as required under the agreement.
